persona_summary: Fictional graduate data science student (M.S. in Data Science, expected May 2027; B.S. in Computer Science, May 2025) with applied experience in machine learning research, predictive modeling, and production-oriented data/AI tooling. Targeting entry-to-mid-level Machine Learning Engineer, Data Scientist, and AI Engineer roles.
_comment_preferences: Drives the Filtering Tool (Section 3.1). min/max_experience_years bound the job's REQUIRED years relative to the candidate, not the candidate's own years worked.
_comment_excluded_companies: Persona-level preference: the candidate does not want to work directly on oil & gas extraction operations. Occidental Petroleum (Oxy) has two postings in ai_ml_jobs.csv, so this exclusion is exercised by the Filtering Tool on a real run.
_comment_master_skills: Section 2.4: everything the candidate actually knows, resume or not. Intentionally incomplete -- skills the candidate confirms during the human-review pause (Section 3.5) are written to memory.json instead of edited here, so the memory mechanism has something real to demonstrate.
